headline: Light.
Leaf.
Season.
heroNote: A collection of small discoveries — plants, changing light, and the things that make me stop and look.
introQuote: There's usually something worth noticing. A leaf turning, a flower opening, light finding its way through.
aboutBody: I'm Sam. I spend a lot of time looking closely at plants — how they change, what the light does to them, and the details that are easy to walk past.
These photographs come out of that habit. Most are made in gardens, with the occasional picture from further afield when something catches my eye.
I've included plant names where I can. If you spot one I've got wrong, I'd be glad to hear from you.
footerBody: You'll find more photographs on Instagram. For a question about an image, a plant identification, or just to say hello, send me a message there.
